title: Run configuration (run.yml)
description: Which plugs a run uses and their non-secret settings. Written by `metrics-agent setup` or by hand. Secrets never go here: each plug reads them from the environment variables it declares. Each input capability and the output take a LIST of plugs, served in the order listed (one history corpus, a schema union, several BI vendors, a scope union). The SQL check is one plug, a list of plugs that each check the databases they hold, or none (parse-only); a run has one SQL dialect. A plug is listed once per run; several sources of the same kind go in that plug's settings.

dialect.description: Read by every stage; never defaulted.

mode.description: Where inputs may come from: `standalone` reads only the customer's own systems; `connected` reads through at least one third-party plug.

publish.description: Never defaulted. An empty list is refused; [files] means publish nowhere.

witness_mode.description: How each statement is checked. Normally the SQL-check plug's own `witness_mode` setting (default explain); here for a run with no SQL check, which is `parse` unless this says `none`.

settings.description: Per-plug, non-secret settings, keyed by plug name.
